This project explores healthcare-related patterns across Australia using an interactive Shiny dashboard.

The dashboard allows users to examine trends, compare regions, and interact with visualisations designed to support data-driven healthcare insights.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## <i class="bi bi-grid-1x2"></i>Key Features

-   <i class="bi bi-hospital"></i> **Healthcare-focused dashboard** for exploring Australian health data
-   <i class="bi bi-bar-chart"></i> **Interactive visualisations** for comparing trends and patterns
-   <i class="bi bi-geo-alt"></i> **Regional analysis** to understand variation across locations
-   <i class="bi bi-search"></i> **User-driven exploration** through filters and dashboard components

## <i class="bi bi-lightbulb"></i>What I noticed

On the surface the numbers look reassuring: 93.7% of elective surgery patients were treated within the recommended time. But the average hides some very long waits. Excision of exostosis stood out at 455 days, well over a year.

Where you live makes a difference too. The ACT had the highest wait pressure of any state, about 55 days longer than the state with the shortest waits.

And the trend isn't going the right way. Wait-time performance is getting worse over time, so this is something to keep an eye on rather than a one-off.
